id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

showTop.description: Whether or not to show the top bar of the content frame.

topBar.description: The component for the top bar. We accept UiSdlContentFrameTopBar or UiSdlContentFrameTopBarSegmented.

showBottom.description: Whether or not to show the bottom bar.

coverage.description:
Whether or not the content frame should wrap the whole page.
Global indicates that all of the content in the page is scrollable and will take up the screen's view height
Local indicates that the content frame will only wrap the content passed into it (not scrollable)
Default is global

content.description: The content to be framed by the Content Frame.

title: Type to represent a content frame.
name: UiSdlContentFrame
